newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk grain board seen holding some 300,000 T barley.
newsitem.headline: Turk grain board seen holding some 300,000 T barley.

text.p: Turkey's state grain board (TMO) may hold as much as 300,000 tonnes of feed barley and at least 50,000 tonnes of malting barley in its stocks, an official said.
The official, who asked for anonymity, said the stocks were left from the TMO's purchases from farmers of about 600,000 tonnes from 1996/97, when Turkey produced about seven million tonnes.
Some traders predicted Turkey might soon enter the market to sell some of its barley stocks before the new crop comes in this summer, but officials did not confirm this.
In February Turkey cancelled a tender to sell 150,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley because of unsatisfactory prices. --Ercan Ersoy, Ankara Newsroom, 90-312-4462940
